name: No More Light
detailed_description:
No More Light is a narrative-driven, post-apocalyptic survival shooter where grotesque insectoid horrors have overrun Earth, and humanity hangs by a thread. You play as a lone survivor, scavenging the ruins of civilization, uncovering buried secrets, and harnessing alien powers in a desperate bid to endure—and possibly strike back.

But survival is just the beginning.

Infect the Enemy

Gain control of insectoid creatures using Parasite Control, a unique gameplay mechanic that lets you infiltrate the swarm, solve environmental challenges, and turn enemies against each other.

Embrace Metamorphosis

Undergo a terrifying transformation as your body fuses with alien biomass. Gain extraordinary abilities—at the cost of your humanity. The line between man and monster begins to blur.

Weaponize the Weather

Command experimental HAARP systems to manipulate the weather in real time. Summon lightning storms, blizzards, and electromagnetic pulses to disrupt alien clusters, expose hidden biomass, or turn the tide in brutal firefights.

Survive the Alien Conspiracy

Theories were true: HAARP is active. The Grays are real. You’ll uncover a story woven with conspiracies, betrayal, and buried knowledge that could decide the future of the planet.

Explore desolate environments. Fight overwhelming odds. Scavenge, upgrade, and evolve in a world where every choice shapes your path—and your morality.


MAIN FEATURES:

  • Tactical third-person survival shooter gameplay

  • A dark, branching story shaped by player decisions

  • Parasite-based possession mechanics to infiltrate and control enemies

  • Dynamic, weather-based environmental manipulation via HAARP

  • Skill upgrades and powers through alien metamorphosis

  • Atmospheric, handcrafted levels blending sci-fi and horror

  • Explore a rich world of post-apocalyptic conspiracy and alien influence


Will you survive the swarm—or become part of it?

short_description: No More Light is a narrative survival shooter where humanity’s last remnants battle an alien insectoid invasion. Thrown into a post-apocalyptic world, you’ll turn enemies into weapons, undergo a deadly metamorphosis, control weather, and fight for survival in brutal, high-stakes combat.
